prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a passenger and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1315; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling through an intersection in Houston, Texas, when the vehicle was struck while Driver 1 was turning left. Driver 2 was proceeding straight through the same intersection and collided with the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat at the time and reported lower back strain after the impact. Responding officers confirmed Passenger's presence in the vehicle through statements from Driver 1 and independent witnesses at the scene. Witnesses interviewed at the scene described the collision in a manner consistent with Driver 1's account, and photographs taken at the location align with the same sequence of events. Driver 2 acknowledged the crash occurred as Driver 1 described it. The damage to Driver 1's vehicle is consistent with the direction and force of the impact, and officers observed no prior damage to the vehicle in the affected areas. Driver 1 is listed as the named driver on the insurance policy covering the vehicle. The reported back injury is consistent with the type and force of a side impact of this kind.
